title: Godot overwriting the saved editor network/language_server/remote_host property when launching project.
body:
### Tested versions

Godot Version: 4.7.1 mono stable


### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Mobile) - dedicated Intel(R) Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.7076) - Intel(R) Core(TM) 3 100U (8 threads) - 15.66 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

wsl versions: 
wsl - 2.7.11
ubuntu on wsl: Ubuntu 26.04 LTS

Im using wsl on windows as my development environment, because of that and because of some windows and wsl network setup, in order to make the gdscript lsp work I need to make it listen on "172.25.0.1" instead of on localhost ("127.0.0.1"). When I simply change that property via the editor and relaunch godot and then go into a project, the property is being overwritten by the default value (localhost). The property is correctly saved in the editor_settings-4.7.tres, but when relaunching the project the setting gets overwritten. Other properties like network/language_server/smart_resolve are being saved and not overwritten when relaunching the project. The property is being overwritten when launching a project, not just when launching godot (so not when just being on the projects selection menu).

I dont know if its intentional so im sorry if it is.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new godot project in version 4.7.1.stable.mono (I dont know if its the only version that has this problem).
2. Go to the network/language_server/remote_host property in the editor settings.
3. Change it to any other value.
4. Relaunch the godot project.
5. Look at the value of the property. (for me it always resets back to the default value)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

The issue also occures in a fully new project.
